craft_notes: Sthāyin: either-or (desire or knowing — set mind in either, undivided). Rows: row 3 (undivided→meaning seen). Close: seen (darśana — the seeing-completion of v97's being: see what it MEANS). Rejected: 'discernment' — killed: meaning kept (artha as purport); 'intention' — killed: set kept (niveśayet — placed).

lines: In desire or knowing, when arisen, mind set:
l4.sanskrit_cite: icchāyām athavā jñāne jāte cittaṃ niveśayet | ātmabuddhyānanyacetās tatas tattvārthadarśanam

reads_against.argmap: What is seen in desire or knowing? → Setting mind undivided in either, seeing of reality's meaning follows.
c1_essence: Either desire or knowing: undivided mind sees meaning.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
